name: Explore DROP 001 product details
description: Verifies a visitor can browse the DROP 001 concepts and open a product detail dialog.
steps: Open details for the dark blue denim concept
expected: The product dialog shows the dark blue SHREDLAB concept and clearly states that orders are not open yet.

name: Navigate the storefront on mobile
description: Verifies the mobile menu opens and its links navigate to the shop sections.
steps: Open the storefront at mobile viewport
expected: The navigation menu opens and the page moves to the DROP 001 product section.

name: Close product details dialog
description: Verifies a visitor can close product information and return to the collection.
steps: Close the dialog using its close control
expected: The first dialog closes and the visitor can open another product detail.
